title: Mitel fixes 5 MiCollab AWV flaws, two critical; Italy's CSIRT relays the advisory
what_changed: The event was dated 17 November from Italy's CSIRT (ACN) alert. Mitel's own advisory MISA-2026-0012, now read and cited first, was first issued on 16 November 2026, so the date is 16 November. Mitel's advisory lists no CVE IDs (a CVE was requested but not yet assigned); the CVE IDs in the record are ACN's.
